585.title: Show the plan name on each invoice
585.body:
## Problem

Invoices do not say which plan they bill.

## Scope

Show the plan name on each invoice line.

## Verification

- A snapshot test shows the plan name.

586.title: Rename 'Seats' to 'Members' on the plan page
586.body:
## Problem

Customers do not understand Seats.

## Scope

Use Members on the plan page.

## Verification

- The plan page reads Members.

587.title: Show plan names in the invoice list
587.body:
## Problem

The invoice list does not say which plan each invoice bills.

## Scope

Show the plan name beside each invoice.

## Verification

- A snapshot test shows the plan name in the list.

591.title: Show plan names in the invoice list
591.body:
Shows the plan name beside each invoice.

Closes #587

files.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- The canonical tracker is GitHub issues in acme/ledger-app, configured in `.agents/managing-issues.json`.
- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
